description: Huawei Cloud alarm baseline configuration read and inspection analysis skill. Fetches all alarm rules for the current account via CES SDK and hcloud AOM CLI, extracts CES and AOM baseline metrics/events from the alarm baseline Excel, compares and analyzes alarm binding status, and generates instance-level binding rate reports and remediation suggestions (Excel + HTML). Use this skill when the user needs to inspect alarm binding coverage, read alarm baselines, analyze alarm rules, or generate alarm binding reports. Triggers include: "告警基线", "告警配置", "告警阈值", "告警巡检", "告警绑定巡检", "alarm bind inspection", "读取告警基线", "生成告警JSON", "分析告警规则", "告警收敛", "CES告警", "AOM告警"
